name: Runner Tests Fixture - Tdd
brief: Proves --tdd (issues #1997/#2001) generates missing members from usage and infers their type, or refuses rather than guesses, and reports every test that depended on generated scaffolding as failed — never a pass.
description: Broken test codeunits covering every inference anchor (assignment-target field, assignment-target/nested-argument/if-condition procedure return type, enum value) plus two refuse cases (bare-statement call, both-sides-unresolved assignment) and one unrelated healthy test codeunit, all in the same bundle. Without --tdd this fixture behaves exactly like EmitExclusionLoudnessTests fixture (exit 3, EMIT-EXCLUDED, zero test results). With --tdd, generated members compile and the referencing test RUNS up to the point of contact, but EVERY test whose compile depended on a generated member reports FAILED, naming the generated member and its inferred type, regardless of what actually happened when it ran; refused cases still report FAILED naming the AL diagnostic; the one unrelated healthy test always passes.
